name: NUS Research Scholarship
amount: Full tuition waiver + S$3,000/month for international PhD students (+S$500/month after the qualifying exam), rates from 1 Jan 2026
dlText: Set by each faculty for August and January intakes
fields: All research fields (engineering, science, computing, arts, social sciences, law, etc.)
note: Indicate scholarship interest in your NUS graduate research application; deadlines and some stipend top-ups differ by faculty (e.g. College of Design and Engineering pays more). Typical award period for PhD is 4 years.

name: NTU Research Scholarship
amount: Tuition fees covered + S$2,000/month for international students (up to +S$500 after the qualifying exam)
dlText: 15 Nov 2026 for several schools (e.g. WKWSCI, Social Sciences, Humanities); others to 31 Dec 2026 or 31 Jan 2027 – time not stated
note: For August 2027 entry; indicate scholarship interest in the PhD application. Maximum 4 years; scholars do teaching duties but have no post-graduation service obligation.

name: A*STAR Research Attachment Programme (ARAP)
amount: S$3,200/month + S$1,500 airfare + S$1,000 settling-in + housing subsidy, medical insurance, conference & IT allowances (no tuition)
dlText: No single deadline – apply via your ARAP partner university
tags: Must be PhD student at partner university

eligibility.note: Matriculated or newly enrolled PhD students at an A*STAR ARAP partner university (any nationality), with at least a Bachelor's with Second-Class Upper Honours or equivalent.

fields: Science, engineering and biomedical research at A*STAR institutes
note: Funds a 1–2 year research attachment at an A*STAR institute during a PhD at a partner university abroad; tuition stays with your home university. Check the partner-university contact list.

name: SUTD PhD Fellowship
host: Singapore University of Technology and Design
amount: Tuition for up to 4 years + S$3,100/month for international students (up to +S$500 after qualifying exam); President's Graduate Fellowship S$4,300/month
dlText: 30 Oct 2026 for January 2027 intake (another SUTD page says 30 Sep 2026) – time not stated
fields: Engineering, architecture & design, computing, science, humanities with technology
note: Scholarship consideration comes with the PhD application. Rates effective 1 January 2026.

name: SMU PhD Research Scholarship
amount: Tuition and registration fees waived + monthly stipend (e.g. Economics: S$2,500/month for foreign students, S$3,000 after qualifying exam, 2024 rates)
dlText: Set per PhD programme – check each school
fields: Business, economics, accountancy, information systems & computer science, psychology, law, social sciences
note: Full-time PhD students are considered for the scholarship on admission; reviewed annually and normally no bond. Stipend rates differ by school.

name: HKU Postgraduate Scholarship (PhD)
amount: HK$19,135/month (HK$19,655 after PhD confirmation), rates from 1 Sep 2026
dlText: Main round 1 Dec 2026 in most faculties (Law 15 Nov 2026) – time not stated
note: Awarded with admission to HKU MPhil/PhD programmes, subject to funding; clearing rounds may follow in April/August. Top applicants can receive the HKU Presidential PhD Scholarship (HK$28,700/month).

name: CUHK Vice-Chancellor's PhD Scholarship Scheme
host: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
amount: HK$80,000 scholarship over 3 years + studentship HK$229,200/year + HK$30,000 travel allowance
dlText: 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 HKT (main round, 2027-28 intake)
note: Outstanding PhD admits are offered this; CUHK HKPFS nominees not selected by the RGC receive a regular PhD place with this scholarship. Results Dec 2026–Jun 2027.

name: HKUST RedBird PhD Award + Postgraduate Studentship
host: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
amount: Studentship HK$19,135/month + RedBird award HK$40,000 (year 1) and up to HK$20,000/year Academic Excellence Award
dlText: Set by each programme (many review on a rolling basis; HKPFS route 1 Dec 2026)
fields: Science, engineering, business, humanities & social science, interdisciplinary
note: Full-time research students receive the Postgraduate Studentship; outstanding PhD admits also get the RedBird PhD Award. Applications for Fall 2027 opened 1 Sep 2026.

name: PolyU International PhD Fellowship Scheme (IPFS)
amount: HK$230,640/year stipend (HK$235,920 after confirmation) + tuition waiver + HK$25,000 conference grant; possible cash award
dlText: 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 HKT (via PolyU's HKPFS round)
note: All foreign PhD applicants to PolyU's HKPFS round are considered for IPFS after the deadline; no separate form. Open to applicants from outside Mainland China, Macau and Taiwan.

name: CityUHK Postgraduate Studentship (PhD)
amount: About HK$19,100/month (2025/26 rate, revised each September)
dlText: Main round ~1 Dec 2026 (estimated from annual December main round; time not stated)
note: Applications accepted year-round but the main round is in December; late applications considered only if places and funding remain.

name: RIKEN International Program Associate (IPA)
amount: Living allowance ¥5,200/day + housing up to ¥70,000/month (off-campus rent), for up to 3 years
dlText: Calls issued twice a year (spring and autumn) – check current call
tags: Must be enrolled at a RIKEN partner graduate school

eligibility.note: International doctoral students enrolled (or enrolling) at a university that has a joint graduate school / collaboration agreement with RIKEN; host researcher's consent needed.

fields: Natural sciences, life sciences, physics, chemistry, engineering, computing at RIKEN centres
note: Lets foreign PhD students do their doctoral research at a RIKEN lab while registered at a partner university. Allowance figures from the IPA page may be dated; confirm in the current call.

name: RIKEN Junior Research Associate (JRA)
amount: ¥250,000/month salary + commuting allowance (up to ¥150,000/month)
dlText: 16 Oct 2026, 13:00 JST (FY2027 call; supervisor's opinion due 6 Nov 2026)

eligibility.note: Any nationality enrolled in a Japanese doctoral programme (as of 1 Apr or 1 Oct 2027) whose graduate school has a joint graduate school or research collaboration with RIKEN; not past the standard PhD term.

note: Part-time paid research position at RIKEN for doctoral students in Japan; contract 1 Apr 2027–31 Mar 2028. Screening results late December 2026.

name: The University of Tokyo Fellowship
amount: ¥200,000/month grant-in-aid (e.g. 3 years in Frontier Sciences)
dlText: Set by each graduate school – usually applied for together with the entrance application

eligibility.note: Self-financed international students with outstanding performance admitted to UTokyo graduate schools (not MEXT/government scholarship holders); details per graduate school.

fields: All fields (offered via participating graduate schools)
note: Run by individual graduate schools, so deadlines and the number of awards differ; check your target school's admissions page. Tuition is not automatically covered.

name: Kyoto University DoGS SPRING Program
amount: ¥2.16 million/year research incentive grant + ¥0.4 million/year research expenses + half tuition exemption (2024 rates)
dlText: Calls via Kyoto University Graduate Division – check current guidelines

eligibility.note: Kyoto University doctoral students of any nationality; those holding a Japanese Government (MEXT) or home-country scholarship are ineligible; cannot be combined with JSPS DC.

note: Cross-school support for outstanding doctoral students; international students receive payments after arriving in Japan. Programme review was updated in July 2026, so confirm current amounts.

name: Tohoku University AGS RISE Program
amount: ¥180,000/month (standard) + ¥340,000/year research grant
dlText: Apply through your graduate school – deadlines set per call

eligibility.note: Tohoku University doctoral course students; check the call for international-student conditions.

note: Replaced Tohoku's JST SPRING support for new doctoral students from FY2025. A separate next-generation AI track pays ¥260,000/month.

name: CAS-ANSO Scholarship (Degree Program, PhD)
host: Alliance of International Science Organizations (ANSO) & Chinese Academy of Sciences
amount: Tuition waiver + living allowance – amount on official page
dlText: ~31 Jan 2027, Beijing time (estimated from 2026 cycle)
tags: Age limit (born after 1 Jan 1991 in 2026 call)
Study at UCAS, USTC or CAS institutes
note: Formerly the ANSO Scholarship for Young Talents; ~300 PhD awards a year. Apply through the UCAS or USTC international admission system; the 2026 call ran 15 Oct 2025–31 Jan 2026.

name: ANSO-CAS-TWAS/UNESCO PhD Scholarship
host: TWAS, ANSO & Chinese Academy of Sciences
amount: Tuition, travel and visa costs + monthly allowance for housing and living – check official page
dlText: ~31 Jan 2027 (estimated from 2026 cycle; time not stated)

eligibility.note: Non-Chinese nationals from TWAS-eligible developing countries, under 35, holding an MSc; must return home after studies.

note: Successor to the CAS-TWAS President's Fellowship; up to 4 years at USTC or UCAS (apply to only one). Only one TWAS fellowship application per year.

name: Westlake University Fellowship (International PhD)
amount: Full tuition waiver + monthly stipend (amount on official page)
dlText: Several application windows a year (e.g. March, August, November) – check graduate admissions
note: All admitted international PhD students are eligible for the Westlake University Fellowship plus tuition-waiving university scholarships. Figures from a 2023 brochure; confirm for 2027.

name: SUSTech First-Grade Scholarship for International PhD Students
host: Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech)
amount: Monthly basic + incentive allowance (see admission guide) + one-off RMB 30,000 Guangdong award in year 1
dlText: ~18 Jan 2027 first round (estimated from 2026 cycle); second round to ~1 Apr 2027
note: All admitted international postgraduates not awarded the Chinese Government Scholarship get the SUSTech First-Grade Scholarship automatically. Apply in the first round to also be considered for CGS.

name: Taiwan International Graduate Program (TIGP) PhD Stipend
amount: NT$34,000/month tax-free in year 1 (+NT$6,000 Research Performance Fellowship for some), renewable 2 more years on performance
dlText: ~1 Feb 2027, GMT+8 (estimated from 2026 cycle)
fields: Chemistry, physics, life sciences, bioinformatics, nanoscience, earth sciences, computing, social networks
note: PhD degrees awarded jointly with partner universities; after year 3 funding depends on the advisor. Applications usually open November–February.

name: Australian Government Research Training Program (RTP) – International
amount: Stipend A$35,550–A$55,537/year (2027 base–max rate, set by university) + tuition fee offset; 3–4 years for PhD
dlText: Set by each university's scholarship rounds
note: Not applied for centrally: each university selects RTP recipients in its own HDR scholarship rounds (often combined with the admission application). Highly competitive for international students.

name: University of Sydney International Stipend Scholarship (USYDIS) + Tuition Fee Scholarship
amount: A$44,293/year stipend (2027 rate) + 100% tuition + OSHC
dlText: 18 Dec 2026 for Research Periods 3–4, 2027 (time not stated)
note: General international research scholarship round; the RP1–2 2027 round closed 11 Sep 2026. Outcomes from 26 Feb 2027.

name: ANU PhD Scholarship (International)
amount: A$40,475/year stipend (2027 base rate) for 3.5 years + tuition fee scholarship
dlText: 15 Apr 2027 (Round 2, start by 31 Aug 2027; time not stated)
nextText: Round 1 International closes 31 Aug each year
tags: Apply for admission and scholarship together
note: Round 1 for internationals (31 Aug 2026) has closed; Round 2 is for both domestic and international applicants.

name: UQ Graduate Research School Scholarship (UQGRSS)
amount: A$39,220/year tax-free stipend (2026 rate, indexed) for 3.5 years + OSHC; tuition cover for internationals – check official page
dlText: 19 Oct 2026 international round (time not stated)
nextText: Next round closes 25 Jan 2027 – check whether open to international applicants
note: Includes RTP-funded awards; outcomes of the international round from 22 Feb 2027.

name: Monash Graduate Scholarship + Monash International Tuition Scholarship
amount: A$41,100/year stipend (2027) + A$2,000 relocation + tuition fees + OSHC
dlText: 28 Feb 2027 international Round 1 (time not stated); Round 3 ~31 Aug 2027
note: The 2027 Round 1 closing date was brought forward from 31 March to 28 February. MITS dates differ on some pages—check the round calendar.

name: Melbourne Research Scholarship (PhD)
amount: check official page (stipend + fee offset)
dlText: 31 Jan 2027 (Round 2 for most faculties; time not stated); Round 3 15 May 2027

eligibility.note: Domestic and international graduate researchers; some faculties (e.g. Engineering & IT) list it for local applicants—check your faculty.

note: Rounds differ by faculty (Engineering & IT closed 11 Oct 2026). Outcomes of the 31 Jan round by 26 Mar 2027.

name: UWA International RTP Stipend and Tuition Fee Scholarships
amount: A$39,253/year stipend (2027) + tuition fees
dlText: 15 Sep 2026, 23:59 AWST (2027 round)
note: UWA international graduates from 2025–26 could also apply in the domestic round (closed 31 Oct 2026) for a small pool of international awards.

name: Adelaide University Research Scholarship (AURS)
amount: About A$36,500/year living stipend (2025 listing) + tuition fee waiver, up to 3.5 years
dlText: Rounds open mid-Feb and mid-Jul 2027 – closing dates on the scholarships site
note: International students awarded a living allowance scholarship also get a tuition fee waiver. Rates shown are from an older round; check the 2027 rate.

name: University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship
amount: Up to NZ$35,468/year tax-free stipend (2026 rate, CPI-adjusted) + tuition fees, up to 42 months
dlText: 1 Feb 2027 (then 1 May and 1 Aug 2027; time not stated)
note: International PhD students pay domestic fees in NZ, which the scholarship covers. International applicants needing a visa are advised to apply in the Nov or Feb rounds.

name: University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship
amount: NZ$34,128/year stipend + domestic tuition fee waiver for 36 months
dlText: 1 Mar 2027 (rounds in Mar, Jun, Sep, Nov; time not stated)
note: Submit via eVision with a completed departmental assessment by the first day of the round month. Student Services Fee and insurance are not covered.

name: Wellington Doctoral Scholarship
host: Te Herenga Waka—Victoria University of Wellington
amount: NZ$32,000/year stipend + tuition fees (domestic) for up to 3 years
dlText: 1 Mar 2027, 16:30 NZDT (rounds 1 Mar, 1 Jul, 1 Nov)
note: Same closing dates for international and domestic applicants.

name: UC Doctoral Scholarship
amount: NZ$32,650/year stipend + tuition fees for thesis enrolment (up to 360 points)
dlText: ~15 May 2027 (estimated from twice-yearly May/Oct rounds; time not stated)
note: The 15 Oct 2026 round (start before 1 Jul 2027) has closed. Check international eligibility details on the UC page.

name: Weizmann Institute (Feinberg Graduate School) PhD Fellowship
amount: About NIS 9,000/month for up to 4.5 years + full tuition waiver
dlText: Applications accepted year-round
fields: Mathematics, computer science, physics, chemistry, biology, biochemistry, science education
note: Admission depends on securing a Weizmann senior scientist as advisor before applying. Extra WSoS awards exist for outstanding international doctoral students.

name: Technion Graduate School PhD Scholarship
amount: Monthly portions (NIS 1,401 each before candidacy, NIS 1,522 after; CS PhD = 6 portions); 4+ portions = full tuition waiver
dlText: Set by each faculty – check graduate admissions
fields: Engineering, sciences, computer science, data science, architecture, medicine
note: Number of portions varies by faculty; doctoral students are generally tuition-exempt. A Technion International PhD Excellence Program also exists.

name: UAEU PhD Scholarship (All Nationalities)
amount: Full tuition waiver + monthly stipend for 4 years (amount on official page)
dlText: Same as the graduate admission deadline for each intake
fields: All UAEU PhD programmes (engineering, science, IT, medicine, business, humanities)
note: Separate Graduate Research Fellowships for international PhD students cover tuition and insurance, with a stipend only if funds allow.

name: University of Sharjah PhD Research/Teaching Assistant Scholarship
amount: Tuition covered + monthly stipend (amount on official page)
dlText: With PhD admission – check current call
fields: All University of Sharjah PhD programmes
note: Competitive RA/TA scholarships, subject to departmental availability; remedial courses not covered.
